product.name: Monoprice Consul Series USB-C DisplayPort Adapter
product.description: Extend your reach and grasp new possibilities your USB Type‑C® computer with the Monoprice Consul™ Series of USB‑C® adapters! By unlocking USB‑C 3.1 functionality, the Consul Series is able to offer a variety options to expand your ability to work anywhere you need or want.This Consul Series USB‑C to DisplayPort® Adapter allows you to connect an external DisplayPort monitor to mirror your laptop's main display or expand your system's desktop area, with support for resolutions up to 4K@60Hz. This adapter is a true Plug and Play device, with no need for drivers or software installations of any kind. Just plug the reversible USB‑C connector into your computer's USB‑C port and connect your DisplayPort monitor using a standard DisplayPort cable (available separately).
